landing.nav.lang.label: PT
landing.hero.one: Agent tools are built for one person.
landing.hero.many: Gambi lets you build for many.
landing.hero.lede: Each person connects the agents and models on their own machine. Your app reaches all of them through one hub.
landing.cmd.failed: Copy failed. Select the command and copy it.
landing.start.title: Run your first session
landing.start.lead: Install the CLI on each machine, start the hub on one of them, and have each person join from their own. The quick start walks through it in four commands.
landing.start.prompt: Copy a setup prompt for your agent
landing.start.promptFailed: Copy failed. Open the quick start and copy the prompt there.
landing.start.promptNote: Paste it into Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode. It reads the docs and walks you through the same steps.
landing.footer.tag: A hub for many people's agents and models, on a network you trust.
landing.display.title: Six people connected to one hub
landing.display.desc: Concentric rings: people's machines on the outside, the tunnels in between, the hub at the centre. Each track is one person's tunnel, opened from their own machine.
landing.display.pick: Pick a person to see what crosses their tunnel and what stays home.
landing.display.caption: An example session with six people. Switch between one person running six agents from one machine, and six people each bringing their own.
landing.display.arthur.stays: Ollama keeps listening on loopback. The hub never calls it.
landing.display.bia.stays: Her Claude login. The CLI checks it locally before joining.
landing.display.lu.stays: The Authorization header from VLLM_AUTH, added only to the local call.
landing.display.caio.stays: ./my-project, the folder he chose. The hub cannot write into it.
landing.display.tati.stays: Her OpenRouter key, read from OPENROUTER_AUTH. It goes only to OpenRouter.
landing.display.duda.stays: The provider credentials OpenCode already has configured.
landing.compare.title: The tools stop at one person
landing.compare.lead: There are dozens of orchestrators that run many agents at once. Nearly all of them assume one person behind the keyboard. Put a group in the same session and four things change.
landing.compare.table: One person compared with many people
landing.compare.question: Question
landing.compare.run.one: One machine or one cloud account.
landing.compare.keys.one: One set of keys for every agent.
landing.compare.keys.many: Each person's own. The hub never sees them.
landing.compare.write.many: In the folder its owner picked. The hub can't write there.
landing.compare.dial.one: One process calls out to the rest.
landing.compare.dial.many: Each machine dials out. The hub never dials in.
landing.compare.close: Gambi handles those four. What the group does together, who drafts, who decides, who reviews, is your code.
landing.wiring.title: One request, end to end
landing.wiring.lead: Your app calls the hub. The hub sends the work down the tunnel the participant opened, and the answer comes back the same way.
landing.wiring.app.name: Your app
landing.wiring.app.body: Calls /rooms/ABC123/v1/responses, or attaches to an agent by participant id.
landing.wiring.hub.name: Hub
landing.wiring.hub.body: Picks a participant by id, model:<name>, or *, and emits llm.request to the room's events.
landing.wiring.tunnel.name: Tunnel
landing.wiring.tunnel.body: A WebSocket the participant opened. tunnel.request goes down, tunnel.response.chunk comes back.
landing.wiring.machine.name: Their machine
landing.wiring.machine.body: The runtime adds the provider key, calls the model on localhost, and streams the answer up.
landing.wiring.caption: What a participant sends to the hub, and what stays on their machine
landing.wiring.row1.cross: Participant id, display name, model name, and a capability summary.
landing.wiring.row1.stay: Provider auth headers set with --header or --header-env.
landing.wiring.row2.cross: The provider URL, as a label. The hub never calls it.
landing.wiring.row2.stay: The provider itself, which can keep listening on localhost.
landing.wiring.row3.cross: Model responses, streamed back up the tunnel.
landing.wiring.row3.stay: The agent's login. It is not part of registration, room events, or tunnel frames.
landing.wiring.row4.cross: ACP messages for an attached session, and the files the agent writes in its workspace.
landing.wiring.row4.stay: The agent process, its tools, and everything outside its workspace folder.
landing.wiring.warnBody: The hub has no built-in authentication. Run it where you trust everyone on the network: your home, your lab, the room your group meets in.
landing.examples.title: What a group can build on it
landing.examples.lead: Pick an example. Each one is your app's code running on one hub, with participants on different machines. The events are illustrative.
landing.examples.arena.title: Model arena
landing.examples.arena.body: Send one prompt to every model in the room and compare the answers side by side, with timing from the room's events.
landing.examples.arena.s5: Your app shows the four answers side by side.
landing.examples.jury.title: Jury panel
landing.examples.jury.body: One model answers and three others score it. Each judge can run on a different person's machine.
landing.examples.debate.title: Debate club
landing.examples.debate.body: Two models argue in turns while a third moderates. Your code decides who speaks next and what each one sees.
landing.examples.chain.title: Draft, critique, polish
landing.examples.chain.body: A small local model drafts, a stronger one critiques, and the first one revises. Cheap where it can be, strong where it counts.
landing.examples.squads.title: Squads with a steerer
landing.examples.squads.body: Squads of people build something together, each squad with its own coding agent. Each round one person steers: they record a decision before work goes to the agent, then accept the result or send it back with a reason. Those rules are app code; Gambi carries the messages.
landing.examples.squads.s0: Round 1 · the challenge goes to every squad
landing.examples.squads.s1: Squad A records a decision, Bia steering
landing.examples.squads.s10: Round 2 · steering passes to the next person
landing.code.title: In your code
landing.code.lead: Models answer on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so the AI SDK or any OpenAI client works. Agents are reached by attaching to the person who shared them.
